summary:
Iter40 — Crossword Hint allowance (ONE hint per clue per puzzle) FE smoke test. ALL 4 ACCEPTANCE CASES PASS via Playwright on mobile viewport 390×844 against /games/crossword/play?daily=1 as maggie. Daily puzzle today = expert-006 'Aussie TV Classics' with active clue '3 ACROSS · 11 letters · Summer Bay soap, run together' (Home and Away — matches the brief exactly).

1) One-and-done per clue (3 ACROSS): clicked Hint → exactly +1 teal letter on the grid (sample reveal letter 'D' rendered in rgb(30,58,127) brand colour, distinct from typed-letter slate rgb(15,23,42)), action button label flipped from 'Hint' (bulb-outline) → 'Hint used' (filled bulb, dimmed). Clicked again → ZERO new letters revealed, toast "You've already used your hint for this clue. Try another!" appeared in the DOM body text. ✓

2) Independent per clue: tapped 'Next' → banner advanced to '5 ACROSS · 6 letters · Bush kangaroo TV star' (Skippy). Hint button reset to label 'Hint' (count 1) with 'Hint used' count 0 — fresh allowance confirmed. Tapped Hint → +1 teal letter ('K' in rgb(30,58,127)), grid total revealed cells now 2 (one per hinted clue). ✓

3) AsyncStorage persistence: after both hints, localStorage['xword.hints.expert-006'] = '["A-3","A-5"]' (correct dir-num keys per the brief). page.reload() → storage value identical post-reload, 2 teal letters still on grid (server progress + hint markers both restored). Clicked the 'Across 3:' clue row in the panel → 'Hint used' label rendered (count 1), 'Hint' count 0. Persistence verified end-to-end. ✓

4) Visual confirmation: revealed-letter cells render in brand teal-blue rgb(30,58,127) while typed letters use slate rgb(15,23,42); wrong-flag letters use red rgb(198,40,40); status banner colour distinct from default. Screenshot saved at /tmp/xword_final.png shows the bordered active-clue banner + clue panel state correctly after the persistence reload.

Note: the test used the API directly (POST /api/auth/demo-login {username:'maggie'}) to obtain the JWT and injected yb_token + yb_user into localStorage because the in-app 'Try a demo account' button didn't expand on this run (likely a transient demos-list fetch issue — unrelated to the iter40 change, pre-existing). Once authenticated this way the play screen loaded normally and all assertions passed.

minor.issue: Returned 422 when called with guesses:null, revealed:null payload (test helper called it to reset state). Not blocking the iter40 feature — guesses/revealed are likely required arrays. Worth surfacing a clearer error or accepting null to mean 'wipe'. Minor.

react_native_issues.issue: shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings and Animated useNativeDriver web warning still present. Same as iter37/38/39 — not in scope of this hint-allowance change.

action_items: (Optional polish) Add testID to the action-row buttons in play.tsx ActionBtn (e.g. testID="xword-hint-btn", testID="xword-check-btn", testID="xword-clear-btn"). Today the only handle is the inner Text label which toggles 'Hint' ↔ 'Hint used' — Playwright tests work via text matching but a stable testID would survive copy changes.

(Optional polish) The brief mentions the cursor jumps to the hinted cell after reveal — visually confirmed via screenshot (selected highlight on the revealed cell) but no testID exposes 'selected cell coords' to test directly. A data attribute on the selected cell would help future automation.
(Optional, backend) /api/games/crossword/progress/{user_id} could accept null guesses/revealed as a 'wipe' rather than returning 422 — useful for test setup. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: play.tsx:324 doRevealLetter — sound implementation: enforces hintedClues.has(activeClueKey) early-return with friendly toast; partitions cells into emptyUnrevealed vs anyUnrevealed (prefers empty-and-unrevealed for max usefulness); falls back to anyUnrevealed if every cell is filled; safe random pick via Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length). Solid.
play.tsx:384 AsyncStorage.setItem fire-and-forget inside setHintedClues updater. The comment explains the worst case (one extra hint after a hard crash) which is acceptable. Good engineering.

play.tsx:155-163 hint-set restore reads xword.hints.{puzzle.id} in the same useEffect that loads the puzzle, so race-free with the server-progress restore. JSON.parse + Array.isArray guard prevents crashes from corrupted storage. Good.
play.tsx:321 activeClueKey uses `${dir}-${activeClue.num}` — correctly distinguishes A-3 from D-3 (same number, different word). Matches the iter40 brief's expected storage shape (A-3, A-5).

play.tsx:790 ActionBtn now takes a `dimmed` prop with default false — Pressable still tappable when dimmed (intentional, so the friendly toast can fire). accessibilityState.disabled is set but element remains pressable — that's the right call for this UX (don't truly disable, just visually de-emphasise + let onPress run to show the toast).
play.tsx:395 doClear correctly skips revealed cells AND preserves 'correct' status on them (line 414). So 'Clear answer' does NOT reset hinted cells (revealed stays locked) — matches brief point 6.

play.tsx:93 hintStorageKey is a const derived from puzzle.id — if puzzle is null it's '', and the consumer (doRevealLetter setHintedClues callback) only runs after a successful reveal which requires puzzle to exist, so the empty key is unreachable. Safe.

(Minor) Hint enforcement currently lives ONLY on the client. A motivated user could clear localStorage between hints to get unlimited reveals. If this matters for the points economy, consider tracking hinted clues in the server-side progress document too. Not blocking — the feature is primarily a UX nudge.

success_rate.backend: N/A (FE-only iter per brief; backend reveal endpoint untouched and still returns the correct letter — verified via the +1 teal-letter delta on each Hint click)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 acceptance cases pass: one-and-done ✓, toast on repeat ✓, independent per clue ✓, AsyncStorage persistence + reload ✓, visual teal colour ✓)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used existing maggie demo account + today's daily expert-006 puzzle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter40 hint-allowance feature is solid. testIDs of interest on play.tsx: crossword-clue-panel-stacked (phone), crossword-clue-panel-wide (tablet). Action buttons (Check / Hint / Clear answer) have NO testIDs — locate via exact text matching ('Hint' vs 'Hint used'). Clue rows are locatable via aria-label='Across N: <clue>' or 'Down N: <clue>'. AsyncStorage key is xword.hints.{puzzle.id} storing a JSON array of '{dir}-{num}' clue keys (e.g. ["A-3","A-5"]). On web, AsyncStorage maps to window.localStorage so all tests can introspect it directly. Today's daily (2026-06-23) is expert-006 'Aussie TV Classics' — daily_puzzle() rotates HARD+EXPERT pool by day index. To bypass the in-app login (which intermittently fails to expand the demos sheet), POST /api/auth/demo-login {username:'maggie'} then localStorage.setItem('yb_token', resp.access_token) and localStorage.setItem('yb_user', JSON.stringify(resp.user)) before navigating to /games/crossword/play?daily=1. Reveal endpoint POST/GET /api/games/crossword/{puzzle_id}/reveal/{r}/{c} is unchanged from iter37+ and still returns {letter:'X'}.
rca_of_issue: N/A — iter40 acceptance criteria all pass on first run.
